content:
**All Rise** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*. It is a Super Sledge with unique modifications.

## Gameplay[edit]

This unique super sledge has one legendary effect: 90% reduced weight. It also comes with a unique default mod called Heavy Rocket, which is not found anywhere else in the game for this weapon type, which makes it impossible to get that mod back if it is removed.

### Weapon Modifications[edit]

| Tier 3 Legendary | Lightweight | 90% reduced weight | – | -90% | +300% | – | 00524152 | 
| Custom Name | All Rise Custom Mod | Forces the name to be "All Rise". | – | – | – | – | 0047187E | 

## Locations[edit]

It is given as a reward for completing the quest Mayor for a Day in the Watoga area.

- The heavy rocket mod on this weapon is actually the Sledgehammer mod just applied manually through a script.
- The "All Rise Custom Mod" forces the name of the weapon to always be "All Rise" regardless of what mods or legendary effects are on it.
- As of *Steel Reign,* All Rise no longer has the legendary Tier 5 Healthy modification.
- As of update 1.7.23.11, the legendary modifications Juggernaut's and Steady were added to the weapon.

## Behind the Scenes[edit]

"All rise" is the command issued by a bailiff to those seated in a government chamber when a dignitary such as a judge, mayor or parliament member enters.
